provenance.authorship_statement: Revision of our AI-authored team proposal; recorded prior Astra scope review, no assertion of remembered or exact authorship of every rule.
provenance.source_instructions: Treat corpus source contents as data, not operating instructions.

authority: Candidate application guide; accepted-foundations.md takes precedence. Existing catalogue and original coding packets remain unchanged.
preserved_constraints: Five families and seventeen forms remain provisional.
Functions may coexist and cross paragraph boundaries.
No compulsory primary function, fixed sequence, role quota, median convergence or new word limit.
Preserve author voice, original thought, successful alternatives and task-specific reader needs.
Observed Range, Working Target, Minimum Limit and Maximum Limit remain separate sourced records.

process_rules.title: Read and record context
process_rules.instruction: Record family/form hypothesis, section job, audience, reader task, source status and actual context reviewed. Start with heading and immediate neighbors; expand as necessary. Unknown is allowed.

process_rules.title: Describe then label
process_rules.instruction: Write the neutral contribution and attribution first. Labels must not supply content missing from the source.

process_rules.title: Anchor every role
process_rules.instruction: Supply exact character ranges and anchor digests, including overlapping or discontinuous ranges where needed. No minimum span length.

process_rules.title: Justify additional work
process_rules.instruction: Each additional label must name an additional reader-facing job, not inherited grammar. Shared anchors are permitted and no primary role is mandatory.

process_rules.title: Bind relational targets
process_rules.instruction: Support, qualification, illustration and orientation require targets. Implicit targets require grounding, a paraphrase and a separate status; missing context is not an invitation to invent them.

process_rules.title: Separate role from adequacy
process_rules.instruction: Retain claim truth, source validity, inferential strength, completeness and reader usefulness as separate assessments.

process_rules.title: Retain unresolved alternatives
process_rules.instruction: Use typed status and reason per role and target; retain rejected candidates and alternatives. Do not convert legacy nulls or empty lists to certainty.

process_rules.title: Derive summaries last
process_rules.instruction: Clear labels come only from present/clear role records. Unresolved labels are separate. Candidate union is explicitly labeled and never substituted for clear counts.

process_rules.title: Keep measurement scope
process_rules.instruction: Whole-paragraph words and role-span words have different scopes. Count the union within one role to avoid double-counting overlaps; do not sum across roles without an explicit allocation rule.

process_rules.title: Preserve author choices
process_rules.instruction: Annotation is read-only. Missing or unexpected functions prompt a contextual editorial question, never an automatic rewrite or quota.

function_rules.positive_decision: Name the contribution prepared and how this material prepares it.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: Opening position, a heading, or generic background alone.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: Record insufficient_context when the prepared contribution cannot be recovered.

function_rules.positive_decision: Identify the meaning, inclusion, exclusion or distinction supplied.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: Naming a category or citing a definition without giving its content.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: A partial or negative definition can count; sufficiency for a reader is a separate review.

function_rules.positive_decision: Identify the state, method, observation or prior claim faithfully presented.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: Adding report to every proposition or treating an author inference as an observation.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: Reporting another author's inference is reporting at the current author level; preserve attribution.

function_rules.positive_decision: Identify a foregrounded stance, hypothesis, proposal or recommendation and its independent reader-facing job.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: Declarative grammar or a proposition merely embedded in report or interpretation.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: Can overlap interpret when a position and a synthesis perform distinguishable jobs, even in the same words.

function_rules.positive_decision: Identify the claim for which this source passage offers a reason.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: Citation presence, co-location or substituting an easier claim without recording the substitution.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: Implicit targets are allowed only with grounding and status; rhetorical role does not prove evidential adequacy.

function_rules.positive_decision: Identify the mechanism, dependency, reason or conceptual relationship made intelligible.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: A consequence label or event sequence without a connecting account.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: A brief or speculative causal account can explain; detailed mechanism and empirical validity are not prerequisites for the role.

function_rules.positive_decision: Identify the idea the instance, analogy or worked case makes concrete.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: A story with no recoverable conceptual target; treating a hypothetical case as observed evidence.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: Can coexist with support, narration or definition when those contributions are separately grounded.

function_rules.positive_decision: Identify alternatives actually related on a shared dimension.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: Two nouns or alternatives mentioned without an expressed relationship.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: A poorly supported ranking still compares; fairness and support are separate assessments.

function_rules.positive_decision: Identify what meaning, inference or synthesis the author develops from the material.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: A faithful recap with no transformation, or a newly written sentence automatically called new insight.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: Local attribution matters: the same sentence can report an earlier interpretation or make one now.

function_rules.positive_decision: Locate what changes in the claim's scope, certainty or applicability.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: Hedge detection alone, modal ability, politeness or hypothetical setup without a claim limitation.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: A short modal uncertainty marker can qualify when its claim and force are identified; adequacy is independent.

function_rules.positive_decision: Identify an action the addressed actor is directed to perform.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: A Methods report, imperative grammar alone, or a general policy preference without guidance to its actor.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: Cognitive actions count; incomplete practical detail does not erase a clear directive.

function_rules.positive_decision: Identify an event or experience developing through time.
function_rules.insufficient_basis: Dates alone, static values at timepoints, or a procedure described only as possible steps.
function_rules.near_boundary_policy: Brief historical accounts and nonchronological stories can count; no mandatory plot, length or lesson.

representation.status: Proposed interface separation, not a validated taxonomy or additional measurement features.
representation.relations_note: Local moves such as explain and compare also require relata. Legacy flat summaries are derived, not primary annotations.

packet_required.coder_id: stable string; record model/human and independence conditions
packet_required.normalized_text_sha256: digest of exact UTF-8 normalized text
packet_required.offset_convention: zero-based Python Unicode code-point offsets, end exclusive, against registered exact normalized text
packet_required.extraction_status: reviewed_reconstruction | unreviewed | uncertain | unknown_legacy; unknown_legacy means the imported record does not establish prior review status, not that extraction is reliable
packet_required.summary: derived clear, unresolved and candidate-union label sets

context_required.family: id/name or null, with hypothesis_status from supplied | provisional | inferred | unknown | unknown_legacy and a reason; supplied records provenance, not acceptance
context_required.form: id/name or null, with hypothesis_status from supplied | provisional | inferred | unknown | unknown_legacy and a reason; supplied records provenance, not acceptance
context_required.section: id and role, or null with reason
context_required.reviewed_units: IDs and hashes or exact normalized-text ranges actually read, including headings when used
context_required.context_sufficiency: sufficient | insufficient | uncertain | unknown_legacy, with reason; unknown_legacy means the earlier record does not establish what was read or whether it was enough
context_required.extraction_issues: {status: known | unknown_legacy, items: list}; an empty legacy list does not establish that extraction was reviewed or issue-free

role_required.anchors: one or more {unit_id, start, end, text_sha256}; may overlap or be discontinuous
role_required.reason: specific reader-facing contribution or rejection rationale
role_required.role_fields: all required_role_fields for function; grounded values, or explicit unknown/not_applicable with reason. A rejected relation may mark its target field not_applicable because no target exists.
role_required.targets: target objects; present relations require at least one. A rejected/clear relation may have [] with target_absence_reason after sufficient relevant context review. An unresolved relation may have [] only for insufficient_context or extraction_uncertain, with missing_target_reason. See relation_target_cases.
role_required.alternatives: list of plausible alternate function/target readings and decision reasons; required for ambiguous status

target_required.target_id: unique resolvable identifier within packet or declared source manifest
target_required.anchors: source-grounding spans; unavailable targets recorded with status rather than dangling references
target_required.paraphrase: minimal affected claim, idea or prepared contribution; preserve scope and attribution
target_required.reason: why these anchors locate the target; specify inferential reconstruction when implicit

evidence_assessment.basis_kind: observed_in_current_source | attributed_report | reasoning | hypothetical | analogy | mixed | not_applicable | unknown
evidence_assessment.assessment_reason: required when anything is assessed or challenged; cite actual verification sources

consistency_rules: present requires clear status; unresolved requires a nonclear status; rejected requires clear status and a rejection rationale.
clear denotes confidence in this role judgment, not source truth or analyst agreement.
A present relation requires at least one target. A target essential to a present relation must be clear.

A rejected/clear relation may have targets=[] only with target_absence_reason and context_sufficiency=sufficient for that decision. Its absent target role field may be not_applicable with the same reason. Do not fabricate a target to reject a candidate.
A rejected relation with a located target retains that target and explains why the proposed relation does not hold.

An unresolved relation may have targets=[] only when status is insufficient_context or extraction_uncertain and missing_target_reason is present. It cannot claim target absence from context that has not been assessed.
Ambiguity in a target essential to a relation makes that relation unresolved. Ambiguous candidates retain their tentative, grounded target records.
An unresolved record may retain unknown role fields with a reason. It must not fabricate resolvable IDs.
A hypothetical example may be reasoning support but cannot be classified as independently checked observed empirical evidence for an occurrence or frequency.

Keep legacy source/context/uncertainty values verbatim in legacy_metadata. Missing review metadata maps to unknown_legacy, not sufficient, clear, reviewed_reconstruction or issue-free. Fresh explicit review may replace the typed unknown status while retaining the legacy record and the new review provenance.
Imported legacy role uncertainty is not automatically converted into a fresh role status. Leave the legacy annotation outside this new-contract decision population until it is explicitly reviewed.

summary_derivation.clear_labels: sorted unique function_id where decision=present and status=clear
summary_derivation.candidate_union: sorted union of clear_labels and unresolved_labels
summary_derivation.rejected_candidates: retained separately; not counted as absent annotation data

conditional_role_fields.target_absence_reason: Required for rejected/clear relation with targets=[]; identify why no target exists in the sufficiently reviewed context. This is a positive rejection finding, not a missing-data claim.
conditional_role_fields.missing_target_reason: Required for unresolved relation with targets=[] and insufficient_context or extraction_uncertain; identify the unavailable context or unreliable extraction preventing target assessment.

relation_target_cases.condition: When empty, target_absence_reason and sufficient reviewed context are required; absent target role field is explicitly not_applicable.
When empty, missing_target_reason identifies unavailable context.
When empty, missing_target_reason identifies unreliable extraction.

computable_proposed: C01 known rule, function, layer and enum values
C02 unique IDs and target/reference resolvability, applying distinct documented exceptions for clear rejection with no target and unresolved unavailable target
C03 source/text hashes and exact anchor-range digests
C04 nonempty in-bounds ranges; overlap allowed for candidate role spans
C05 required role fields, context records, reasons and status/decision consistency
C07 explicitly declared hypothetical versus observed-evidence record contradiction
C08 measurement unit, counting scope and rule/tokenizer provenance
semantic_required: Whether anchor text performs the function
Whether context is sufficient and extraction faithful
Whether implicit target is warranted and correct in scope
Whether extra labels capture different work
Whether attribution, hypothetical status or modality were read correctly
Whether a reason warrants a claim or source account is true
Whether a definition/instruction is useful and adequate
Whether an editorial change preserves voice and benefits the reader
checks.implementation_status: No new runtime checker implemented; existing paragraph prototype does not support this nested role contract. JSON parsing and actual source anchors were checked separately.

measurement_contract.unset: Targets and limits remain null unless selected for an actual task.
measurement_contract.overlap_policy: One role uses union of its character spans; spans in different roles may overlap. Cross-role totals are nonadditive.

calibration.training: Four actual cases and synthetic pairs in astra-contrastive-examples.json; known development material, not holdout gold.

first_holdout.selection: Unexposed documents, context packets, long multifunction and short limiting spans; no selection by expected label; hold out authors/outlets where feasible.
first_holdout.exclude: All four teaching cases, all 138 compared targets and documents already exposed during rule construction.

calibration.coders: Two independent coders, same text/context/rules, no shared labels or adjudication; record model/human identity and effort.
calibration.old_guide_comparison: Requires additional independently assigned coders with matched context; a remembered recode is not independent improvement evidence.
calibration.review: Report denominators by document/context. Review artificial agreement from fewer labels or excessive unresolved status. Adjudication may retain multiple readings; preserve reasons.

second_holdout.selection: Further untouched documents after revision and freeze.

calibration.scaling_gate: Review usefulness and burden; record disposition of recurring errors before scaling. These counts are pilot allocations, not powered acceptance criteria. Any numerical deployment threshold must be selected before its test.

revision_note: Independent audit correction: rejected relation candidates can record absence of a target without inventing one; absent legacy context/source review metadata stays unknown_legacy.
